CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.infra_initialize(p_store_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE c public.infra_monitor_configs;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.infra_is_developer(p_store_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'infra_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  FOR c IN INSERT INTO public.infra_monitor_configs(store_id,environment,provider,enabled,updated_by)
    SELECT p_store_id,e,p,e='development' AND p='supabase',auth.uid()
    FROM unnest(ARRAY['development','commercial_production']) e
    CROSS JOIN unnest(ARRAY['supabase','vercel']) p
    ON CONFLICT(store_id,environment,provider) DO NOTHING RETURNING *
  LOOP
    INSERT INTO public.infra_config_audit(config_id,actor_id,action,config_version)
      VALUES(c.id,auth.uid(),'initialize',c.version);
  END LOOP;
END;
$function$

functions.name: infra_is_developer
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.infra_is_developer(p_store_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p
    JOIN public.store_users su ON su.user_id=p.id
    JOIN public.stores s ON s.id=su.store_id
    WHERE p.id=auth.uid() AND p.active AND su.active AND s.active
      AND su.role::text='developer' AND s.id=p_store_id);
$function$
